mapper.insert: MERGE INTO T_BRANCH t USING (SELECT #{termGroupId,jdbcType=CHAR} AS TERM_GROUP_ID, #{branchCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS BRANCH_CD, #{branchName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS BRANCH_NAME FROM dual) s ON (t.TERM_GROUP_ID = s.TERM_GROUP_ID AND t.BRANCH_CD = s.BRANCH_CD AND t.BRANCH_NAME = s.BRANCH_NAME) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (TERM_GROUP_ID, BRANCH_CD, BRANCH_NAME, BRANCH_TYPE_CD) VALUES (#{termGroupId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{branchCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{branchName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{branchTypeCd,jdbcType=CHAR})
